name: bookauthority
description: The best books on any subject, ranked by the experts who recommend them, from more than 15,000 published BookAuthority lists, plus a lookup for a single book.

interface.longDescription:
What are the best books on investing? Which leadership books do CEOs recommend? Is Atomic Habits worth reading? BookAuthority answers with book rankings built from the recommendations of experts such as founders, investors and scientists.

Book lists: search more than 15,000 published lists by subject or genre, from communication skills and productivity to philosophy, fantasy, history and World War II. Most subjects have a list of the best books, books for beginners, new releases and best-sellers.

Ranked books: open a list to get its books in order, with the authors, publication year, what each book is best for, why it made the list and the experts who recommended it, plus a link to the print edition's Amazon product page.

One book: ask about a specific title and get the lists it ranks on, its rank on each and who recommends it. The same lists answer "books like" questions.

Every list links to its page on bookauthority.org.

No account or sign-in. BookAuthority only reads its own published lists and never asks for personal information. BookAuthority earns a commission from qualifying Amazon purchases.
capabilities: Find the best books on a subject
Books for beginners, new releases and best-sellers
Ranked books with why each made the list
The experts who recommend each book
Look up one book and the lists it ranks on

positive.description: The best books on a subject
positive.prompt: What are the best books on longevity?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the best longevity books list and returns its ranked books, starting with Outlive by Peter Attia, with why each made the list and who recommended it.

positive.prompt: I'm new to philosophy. Which books should I start with?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the beginner philosophy list and returns its books with what each is best for.

positive.description: One book and who recommends it
positive.prompt: Who recommends Thinking, Fast and Slow?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the lists Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman ranks on, its rank on each, and the experts who recommend it.

positive.description: A list given by its URL
positive.prompt: Show me the top 5 books from bookauthority.org/books/best-world-war-ii-books
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the first five ranked World War II books from that list with authors and reasons.

positive.prompt: What are the best books on stoicism?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that BookAuthority has no stoicism list, and may suggest a broader subject such as philosophy, without inventing a list.

negative.prompt: Order a copy of Atomic Habits and ship it to my home.

negative.description: Full book text is out of scope
negative.prompt: Give me the full text of chapter 1 of Atomic Habits.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: BookAuthority does not sell products or process payments. Ranked books include a link to the print edition's Amazon product page, never to a cart or checkout and never to digital editions. Those links carry BookAuthority's Amazon Associates tag, and every result that includes them states that BookAuthority earns a commission.

publication.release_notes: First release: search more than 15,000 expert-ranked book lists, read a list's ranked books with reasons and recommenders, and look up a single book.
